verdict.rationale: Figma's REST API and Plugin API let users extract objects, layers, variables, and properties (figma-docs-7, figma-docs-49, figma-docs-62), and SVG export/copy is available per-asset, but there is no first-party or evidence-based full-data-export path into a genuinely open standard format, and a hands-on community report explicitly states files are 'locked up in a proprietary format' with no way to keep a fully up-to-date local copy (figma-comm-7) — directly contradicting a clean 'export everything and leave' capability. missing for 10: a documented bulk/full-project export to an open standard format, evidence that exported data preserves full fidelity outside Figma, and confirmation this contradicts the community claim of proprietary lock-in.
